capture_byte_check: direct byte equality to capture-tool output receipt
control_hash_rule: All fresh raw arrays are independently hashed. Old control comparisons use the recorded defined-word hashes and metrics; undefined optional horizontal native words are excluded only by the oracle mask.
native_reference_rule: Every recorded exact comparison hash, metric and level row is reproduced from fresh arrays; whole-production identity to native WRF is not claimed.
scope: Independent offline returned-artifact audit, no CUDA device use
